project.title: 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing of denitrifying sludge treated with alkali-treated banana peel leachate
project.description: This project investigated bacterial community profiles in batch denitrification systems amended with different carbon sources or different initial nitrate-nitrogen concentrations. The study focused on denitrifying sludge communities associated with alkali-treated banana peel leachate as an alternative carbon source.
